import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, model as M, analyze as AN
import z3
rng = random.Random(1)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False)
inst = AN._parse_request(req)
m = M.build(inst)
base = m['base']; q = m['q']; n = m['n']; bvars = m['bvars']; bmap = m['bmap']
viol = m['viol']; L = m['L']; snaps = m['snaps']
k = 13
target = n[1][4]

def run(addfn, tag):
    o = z3.Optimize(); o.add(*base); addfn(o)
    h = o.minimize(target)
    t0=time.time(); r = o.check(); dt=time.time()-t0
    print('%-34s %.2f %s %s' % (tag, dt, r, o.lower(h)), flush=True)

run(lambda o: None, 'hard only')
run(lambda o: o.add(z3.PbEq([(b,1) for b in bvars], k)), 'pbeq 13')
run(lambda o: o.add(z3.PbEq([(b,1) for b in bvars], 0)), 'pbeq 0')
# explicit enumeration of the clean domain
for d in bmap:
    def mk(d=d):
        def f(o):
            for (s, o_bs) in m['obs_by_dom'][d]:
                metric = o_bs[1]; lo = o_bs[3]; hi = o_bs[4]
                sc = L if metric == 'link' else 1
                o.add(n[s][m['obs_eid'][o_bs[0]]] >= lo*sc) if False else None
        return f
# simpler: add "all observations of d satisfied" via the violated lits negated
for d in bmap:
    lits = viol[d]
    def mk(d=d, lits=lits):
        def f(o):
            for l in lits:
                o.add(z3.Not(l))
        return f
    run(mk(), 'clean=%s' % d)
